mapper.select: select sys_permission.perm_code from sys_user_role left join sys_role_permission on sys_user_role.role_id = sys_role_permission.role_id left join sys_permission on sys_role_permission.permission_id = sys_permission.id where sys_user_role.user_id = #{userId}
select role_key from sys_user_role role_user left join sys_user user on role_user.user_id = user.id left join sys_role role on role_user.role_id = role.id where role_user.user_id = #{userId}
